title: Mali: marabouts Aboubacar Traoré and Noumouké Gonsoko placed in pre-trial detention over online charlatanism and attempted fraud
date_note: mali24.info's article of 25 November gives no earlier day for the detention order.
summary: According to mali24.info, a first deputy prosecutor of Mali's national cybercrime unit (Pôle national de lutte contre la cybercriminalité) ordered pre-trial detention for Aboubacar Traoré, known as "Bamariamka Batio", and Noumouké Gonsoko. They are accused of charlatanism and attempted fraud through information and communication technologies. The article describes promises of quick wealth or supernatural solutions sold through live broadcasts, viral videos and private messages, without saying which platforms the two used.
plain: Two self-styled spiritual healers in Mali were jailed pending trial, accused of charlatanism and attempted fraud online, according to mali24.info.
exec: Mali's cybercrime prosecutors are acting against online fraud sold through social media, according to mali24.info.
geo_basis: Mali (country); the article names no city
org: Pôle national de lutte contre la cybercriminalité (Mali)

validation.note: Only mali24.info read; no official Malian statement found.

review.note: stronger than the source: platforms described generally, not tied to the suspects
